neighbours.label: correcting a description: 'more like', 'more so', Spanish 'más bien' ('not a lake, more like a pond')
fire: He isn't a hero. More like a coward.
It's not a lake, more like a pond.
The rain was heavy, more like a flood.
She's less a boss and more like a friend.
It was noise more so than music.
Esta idea es más bien una sugerencia.
No fue un error, más bien un olvido.
quiet: He isn't a hero. He is a coward.
It's not a lake, just a pond.
The rain was heavy, like a flood.
She's a boss and also a friend.
It was more noise than music.
No fue un error, fue un olvido.
